data.description: This view of Jupiter was taken by Voyager 1. This image was taken through color filters and recombined to produce the color image. This photo was assembled from three black and white negatives by the Image Processing Lab at Jet Propulsion Laboratory.  http://photojournal.jpl.nasa.gov/catalog/PIA01384
